title: BCCDC-PHL/threshold pipeline - params.project_kraken2_dbs schema
description: Kraken2 databases per project: one row per project_id + kraken2_db pair; a project may appear on several rows. The reserved kraken2_db value 'default' means the --kraken2_db database.

project_id.errorMessage: project_id may only contain letters, numbers, underscores, hyphens and dots (as in the samplesheet)

kraken2_db.errorMessage: sylph_db must be a path to a kraken2 db dir (no spaces), or the word 'default' for the --kraken2_db database
